# Kill any ghost processes that are hogging RAM
pkill -9 python
pkill -9 curl
gpgconf --kill gpg-agent
Phase 2: The Ultra-Light "Direct" BridgeWe are skipping Python entirely. This new bridge is just a single line of code that uses your phone's native curl tool—it's fast, light, and won't crash.Run this to create the new, stable Ziggy:Bashcat << 'EOF' > ~/ziggy
#!/data/data/com.termux/files/usr/bin/bash
# Trinity Ultra-Light Build
PROMPT="${1:-System check: Are you there?}"
curl -s -X POST "https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/models/gemini-2.0-flash:generateContent?key=$GEMINI_API_KEY" \
 -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
 -d "{\"contents\": [{\"parts\":[{\"text\": \"$PROMPT\"}]}]}" | grep -oP '"text":\s*"\K[^"]+'
EOF
